prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel art dinosaur character model sheet for Dino Realms. EXACT regular GRID: 3 columns, 5 rows, equal cells, no gaps other than transparent padding. Row order TOP TO BOTTOM: T-Rex (broad snout small arms heavy tail), Raptor (narrow snout feather crest slender tail sickle claw), Triceratops (exactly three horns wide frill), Ankylosaurus (low armored segmented back club tail), Brachiosaurus (long upright neck small head high shoulders). Column order LEFT TO RIGHT: baby, juvenile, adult. Exactly 15 full body characters, one centered per cell, all face right in 3/4 side view, shared baseline within each row. Baby small cute with simplified outfit and training token, juvenile medium functional equipment, adult large ornate equipment. Maintain species anatomy and identity between stages. Detailed deliberate crisp PIXEL ART with visible square pixel clusters and stepped shading, dark 1-2 logical pixel outlines, limited color palette, no smooth illustration, no blur, no antialiasing. Fantasy cartoon armed dinosaur heroes, not human bodies wearing dinosaur heads. All feet tails horns weapons fully inside their cells with 10% padding, absolutely no overlap into adjacent cells. Transparent background, no shadows or scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Canvas 1536 wide x 2560 tall, each cell square. Element and fixed equipment: charcoal orange lava, red black samurai armor; T-Rex flaming katana, Raptor twin ember daggers, Triceratops fire lance, Ankylosaurus forge hammer, Brachiosaurus brazier staff
